history: all 28 training-rated recipes per user, regardless of rating
parent_policy: one source-asserted edge; exclude parents observed in more than 5% of mapped cohort recipes
selection_policy: SHA256(seed|user_id|review_id), four lowest hashes per user go to random_50; remaining four are categorized without test ratings
scope: diagnostic subdivision of the already frozen chronological test split; not a new model split or validation set
